screen.method: Android compositor screenshots from the active display. Compare the same SurfaceView inset by two physical pixels per side. The camera and scene are stationary.

note: The first phone run verified terrain pixels, removal and reload. Its driver searched for a mixed-case Android button label and did not collect the final close. The successful run matched the button case-insensitively, using the identical signed APK. The Snow Temple chapters, lighting and presentation timing retain their separate records.
